label: Exact content and truth-preserving record transmission
term: exact content and truth-preserving record transmission
resolution: Exact decoded-content identity and preservation of truth are distinct. SourceGuarantee uses only RECORD_TRANSPORT_2. CopyGuarantee has the exact-value target and uses RECORD_TRANSPORT_1 on the target range. transportWeakens explicitly derives sense 2 from sense 1 on one unchanged channel and domain; the retagging control refutes the converse in the stated structural model. Neither sense is epistemic entitlement or source identification.
